title: symphony-copilot WORKFLOW.md front matter
description: The YAML front matter of WORKFLOW.md. The Markdown body after it is the implementer's prompt, a Liquid template (variables: docs/reference.md#prompt-templates). Every column named here must be an option of the board's Status field; `symphony setup-board` creates a board with exactly these options. Validate a file with `symphony check`: this schema lists the keys, the orchestrator checks the values.

owner.description: User or organization that owns the project board.

project_number.description: Number in the board URL (.../projects/<number>). Leave it out until the board exists: `symphony setup-board` creates the board and writes the number here.

repo.description: Repository as owner/name. Only its issues are dispatched; branches and pull requests go here.

token.description: A $ENV_VAR reference to a GitHub token with the project and repo scopes. Never write the token itself here. bin/symphony fills SYMPHONY_GITHUB_TOKEN from `gh auth token`.

status_field.description: Single-select field whose options are the columns.

priority_field.description: Single-select field with options like P1, P2 (the number is the priority; lower runs first), or a number field.

identifier_prefix.description: Prefix of issue identifiers in logs, prompts and workspace names.

agent_states.description: Columns the agent may move its card to with tracker_set_status, typically the in-progress column and blocked_state. Without it that tool is not offered.

handoff_state.description: Column tracker_submit_for_review moves the card to. With review, one of review.states; otherwise a waiting column such as Human Review. Never an implementer column, or the agent starts again right away.

blocked_state.description: Column the orchestrator moves a card to when its run reaches a run limit. Not an active column and not in merge_conflicts.states. Without it, a halted card stays where it is.

evidence_branch.description: Branch that stores screenshots attached to submissions. Never merged; keep it, or the images stop loading.

followups.description: Lets agents file out-of-scope problems as new issues with tracker_create_followup.

labels.description: Labels of the new issues. Never a label from tracker.required_labels: a person decides when a follow-up is worked on.

priority.description: Priority option of the new card, for example P4.

required_labels.description: Only issues with all these labels are dispatched (case-insensitive). Usually [agent].

active_states.description: Columns agents work on, in board order. Includes review.states and merge_conflicts.return_state.

terminal_states.description: Finished columns. The workspace of a card here is deleted.

interval_ms.description: How often the board is read.

root.description: One folder per issue is created here. Supports ~, $VAR and paths relative to WORKFLOW.md. Keep it outside the repository and use one orchestrator per root; the run ledger .symphony-ledger.json lives here.

hooks.description: Shell scripts run with `bash -lc` inside the workspace, with network access (agents have none) and without tracker tokens. Variables: SYMPHONY_ISSUE_ID, SYMPHONY_ISSUE_IDENTIFIER, SYMPHONY_ISSUE_BRANCH, SYMPHONY_WORKSPACE, SYMPHONY_WORKSPACE_KEY, SYMPHONY_ROLE (implement or review) and, for the reviewer, SYMPHONY_IMPLEMENTER_WORKSPACE.

after_create.description: Runs once in the new, empty workspace: clone the repository, switch to $SYMPHONY_ISSUE_BRANCH, install dependencies. A failure fails the attempt.

before_run.description: Runs before every session; a failure fails the attempt. With review, reset the reviewer's workspace to the pushed branch when $SYMPHONY_ROLE is review.

after_run.description: Runs after every session; a failure is logged and ignored.

before_remove.description: Runs before a workspace is deleted; a failure is ignored.

max_sessions.description: Copilot sessions per card per run. A run ends when the card leaves the active columns.

usage_comments.description: Comment the usage of every session on the issue.

max_concurrent_agents_by_state.description: Column name to the most agents working that column at once.

continuation_prompt.description: Liquid template sent at the start of every later turn. Variables: issue, turn, max_turns.

cli_path.description: Copilot CLI binary to run instead of the runtime bundled with the SDK.

model.description: Model for the implementer, for example auto or a model id. Omit for the runtime default.

max_ai_credits.description: Per-session cap enforced by the runtime, which tells the model; prefer max_ai_credits_per_issue.

max_ai_credits_per_issue.description: AI credits per card per run, enforced by the orchestrator without telling the model.

turn_timeout_ms.description: Longest silence between session events within a turn.

stall_timeout_ms.description: The orchestrator restarts an agent silent this long; <= 0 disables it.

shell_allow.description: Commands allowed in addition to the built-in git and file tools, matched by prefix (for example `npm test`). Exact build and test commands are safer than interpreters like `node` or `python3`, which can run anything.

shell_deny.description: Commands denied in addition to the built-in list. Deny wins.

read_allow.description: Directories outside the workspace the agent may read, such as a toolchain.

url_allow.description: URL prefixes the agent may fetch.

user_input_reply.description: Automatic answer when the agent asks a question.

review.description: An independent reviewer agent that checks every submission in its own session and workspace before a person sees it.

states.description: Columns worked by the reviewer; also listed in tracker.active_states. Make one of them tracker.provider.handoff_state.

prompt_file.description: Reviewer prompt, a Liquid template relative to WORKFLOW.md. Variables: issue, attempt, review_round, max_review_rounds, implementer_workspace.

model.description: Ideally a different model family from the implementer.

pass_state.description: Column for approved work, a waiting column such as Human Review; not an active column.

fail_state.description: Column for requested changes, an active column worked by the implementer such as Rework.

max_rounds.description: After the last round, a failing card goes to pass_state for a person to decide.

continuation_prompt.description: Liquid template for later reviewer turns. Variables: issue, turn, max_turns.

merge_conflicts.description: Sends a waiting card back to the implementer, ahead of other work, when its pull request stops merging.

states.description: Waiting columns whose open pull requests are checked on every poll; not active, not terminal.

return_state.description: Active implementer column the card is moved to, such as Rework.
